detail.longDescription: Any suggestions how to deal with these type-hint errors in PyCharm related to a datetime variable which initially starts off as None but then gets set at a later time. As far as I can tell datetime doesn't allow an empty datetime to be set, hence the reason for using None initially. Started off with: sess_last_cleaned = None ... sess_last_cleaned = datetime.datetime.now() log_entry = "- Session Clean, previous: " + str(sess_last_cleaned) But type-hints gives the error: Type 'datetime' doesn't define ' str ' or ' repr ', so the result might not be useful So tried changing to: sess_last_cleaned = None log_entry = "- Session Clean, previous: " + (sess_last_cleaned.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') if sess_last_cleaned else "None") but this still errors with: Unresolved attribute reference 'strftime' for class 'None'
